rows.note: Both rows pass the automatic checks but miss the tone (writer handoff 2a): each reads as a neutral incident report. Give each one human detail beside one institutional one, where the humour comes from a procedure or form caring about the wrong thing while the world ends (never a joke, never a witty last line). Keep the pieces, places, leans, rival readings and axioms; only title and body change.

row.rival_reading: The call may have concerned routine field work; a missed handoff alone does not show that officials knew of a wider emergency.
row.gloss: A field call is deferred while the road channel lacks coverage.
row.title: Road channel uncovered
row.body: The handheld set sat beside the shift sheet; the road channel was left uncovered after 18:00. One field call was marked to wait until morning.

row.rival_reading: The items may have been held as an ordinary precaution during containment; an unclaimed supply set does not establish that the program caused an exposure.
row.gloss: Agricultural supplies remain grouped with a filter and go uncollected overnight.
row.title: Field kit left overnight
row.body: The sprayer and fertilizer were kept beside a filter after a field check. Nobody returned to collect the kit before the desk closed.
